title: Workload-aware quant defaults and safety rollout for FP8/INT8
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce workload-aware per-model quantization defaults (FP8 and INT8) in the model catalog with integrated calibration workflows, automated accuracy validation, and a staged rollout + rollback safety net. Deliverables: quant default metadata schema, calibration runner, CI/Canary gating, and console guardrails for suggested profiles.
background: We need consistent, safe defaults for per-model quantization to reduce token costs while preserving accuracy. Prior experiments show FP8 gives large memory savings for decoder-heavy models while INT8 benefits smaller encoder-decoder models. Current catalog lacks automated calibration and runtime guardrails, causing manual risk for engineers and product teams.
proposal: Provide a per-model 'quant profile' that includes: recommended primary profile (FP8/INT8/mixed), secondary fallback profile, required calibration dataset fingerprints, baseline metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/perplexity/embedding-cosine), and a confidence band for automatic rollback. Implement an automated calibration pipeline that runs on a golden testset plus sampled customer workload, emits metrics and artifacts, and registers a provenance tag in the catalog. Enforce CI gating: quant profiles require a delta <X% on primary metrics or else default to safer profile during deploy.
technical_decisions: Use dual-phase calibration: static calibration (activation ranges via representative batches) followed by shadow inference on a validation harness to measure end-to-end metrics.
Calibration runner will compute per-layer scale/zero-point candidates and evaluate symmetric vs asymmetric quant schemes; results stored as flat artifact blobs with checksum.
Default heuristics: prefer FP8 for autoregressive decoders where head_dim>=64 and seq_len<=4096; prefer INT8 for encoder-decoder translation/embedding heavy models with small activations.

Hardware compatibility matrix enforced at catalog ingestion: allow FP8 only on validated kernels/hardware (H100 with apex-fp8 kernel, selected Triton kernels). INT8 allowed on A100/H100/Neurons with validated kernel flags.
Fallback chain: primary -> reduced-bit mixed-precision -> FP16 -> float32. Runtime routing will pick highest-performance compatible profile that passes confidence checks.
CI gating threshold: metric-specific deltas: perplexity <= +3%, ROUGE/ BLEU >= -2%, embedding cosine >= -0.005 absolute. Exceeding thresholds marks profile 'requires review'.
acceptance_criteria: Quant profile schema merged to model-catalog proto and backward-compatible with existing entries
Calibration runner implements static and shadow phases and publishes artifacts with checksums
Automated validation job produces human-readable report comparing baseline and quantized metrics and flags risky deltas
Console UI surfaces recommended profile, hardware compatibility, confidence band, and a one-click 'start shadow rollout' action
Canary rollout that serves 1% shadow traffic for 48h with automatic rollback on metric breach implemented
Documentation (Confluence) and runbook for ops to triage calibration failures
tasks: Design quant profile schema and catalog fields (proto + migration plan)
Implement calibration runner: static range collection, per-layer calibration, and artifact storage
Build shadow validation harness and metric aggregator (BLEU/ROUGE/perplexity/embedding-sim)
Integrate hardware kernel whitelist and annotate catalog entries
Add CI gating checks to model ingestion and PR checks
Console: display profile + confidence band + start/cancel shadow rollout
Run k-fold sample calibrations for top 20 models in catalog and collect baselines
blockers: Kernel vendor variance: some FP8 kernels return non-deterministic low-level FP behavior; need vendor sign-off
Golden dataset curation pending legal review for a subset of customer data samples
Bandwidth to adapt older runtime paths to mixed-precision fallback logic
risks_mitigation: If FP8 kernel reliability is uncertain, mark profile as 'experimental' and require manual approval for production rollout
Use conservative CI thresholds initially and expand once more models pass calibration
Implement telemetry that detects quality regressions quickly and enables immediate fallback to safe profile
notes: Prototype runs completed for trans-1.3B and rwkv-14B; FP8 reduced memory by ~30% with perplexity +1.8% on synthetic validation
INT8 experiments show regression concentrated in attention softmax tails; mitigation by outlier clipping and per-layer scale tuning recommended
